data.one_liner: Smooth scrolling ListView for desktop and web
data.what_it_does: Provides ListView constructors that replace the standard ListView with smoother mouse wheel scrolling. It works on web, desktop, and mobile platforms and can switch between smooth and classic scrolling modes.
use_when: You need smoother mouse wheel scrolling on desktop or web
You want a drop‑in replacement for ListView that preserves all parameters
You want to support both smooth and classic scrolling modes
avoid_when: You only need basic scrolling and want to keep dependencies minimal
You are targeting only mobile and do not care about mouse wheel behavior
strengths: Smooth scrolling with mouse wheel and trackpad
Drop‑in replacement for all ListView constructors
Supports switching between smooth and classic modes
weaknesses: No arrow key scrolling support (removed in 2.0.0)
Only works with ListView, no custom scrollable widgets
Limited to smooth scrolling, no other animation features
